name: megin
description: Portable, evidence-driven Megin workflow for classifying, implementing, reviewing, verifying, and delivering repository changes.

interface.shortDescription: Classify, implement, review, verify, and deliver work safely.
interface.longDescription: A portable repository workflow that scales governance to the task, delegates implementation to one authorized writer, requires a fresh read-only review, and records verification before delivery.
defaultPrompt: Describe what you want to build and let Megin guide the design.
Implement this approved plan with TDD and a fresh review.
Verify the change and leave an unstaged feature branch with a suggested commit.
